arxiv-1809-01036.title: A Roadmap for End-to-End Robust Alignment
arxiv-1809-01036.creator: Lê Nguyên Hoang
arxiv-1809-01036.description: Abstract As algorithms are becoming more and more data-driven, the greatest lever we have left to make them robustly beneficial to mankind lies in the design of their objective functions. Robust alignment aims to address this design problem. Arguably, the growing importance of social medias’ recommender systems makes it an urgent problem, for instance to adequately automate hate speech moderation.

arxiv-2002-05188.title: Social and Child Care Provision in Kinship Networks: an Agent-Based Model
arxiv-2002-05188.creator: Umberto Gostoli
arxiv-2002-05188.description: Abstract Abstract Providing for the needs of the vulnerable is a critical component of social and health policy-making. In particular, caring for children and for vulnerable older people is vital to the wellbeing of millions of families throughout the world.

arxiv-2102-10507.title: Multivalley dark solitons in multicomponent Bose-Einstein condensates with repulsive interactions
arxiv-2102-10507.creator: Yan-Hong Qin 1,3, Li-Chen Zhao 1,2,3, Zeng-Qiang Yang 4, Liming Ling 5
arxiv-2102-10507.description: Abstract We obtain multivalley dark soliton solutions with asymmetric or symmetric profiles in multicomponent repulsive Bose-Einstein condensates by developing the Darboux transformation method. We demonstrate that the width-dependent parameters of solitons significantly affect the velocity ranges and phase jump regions of multivalley dark solitons, in sharp contrast to scalar dark solitons.

arxiv-2112-09645.title: Local contrastive loss with pseudo-label based self-training for semi-supervised medical image segmentation
arxiv-2112-09645.creator: Krishna Chaitanya, Ertunc Erdil, Neerav Karani, and Ender Konukoglu
arxiv-2112-09645.description: Abstract Supervised deep learning-based methods yield accurate results for medical image segmentation. However, they require large labeled datasets for this, and obtaining them is a laborious task that requires clinical expertise. Semi/self-supervised learning-based approaches address this limitation by exploiting unlabeled data along with limited annotated data.

First we discuss limit properties of transition functions of the process.

arxiv-2301-01456.title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
arxiv-2301-01456.creator: Maxime Burchi, Radu Timofte
arxiv-2301-01456.description: Abstract End-to-end Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems based on neural networks have seen large improvements in recent years. The availability of large scale hand-labeled datasets and sufficient computing resources made it possible to train powerful deep neural networks, reaching very low Word Error Rate (WER) on academic benchmarks.

arxiv-2306-01785.title: Beyond Rankings: Exploring the Impact of SERP Features on Organic Click-through Rates Thanks: * Note: these authors contributed equally to this work and shared first authorship
arxiv-2306-01785.creator: Erik Fubel 1 , Niclas Michael Groll 1 , Patrick Gundlach 1 , Qiwei Han 1 , Maximilian Kaiser 2
arxiv-2306-01785.description: Abstract Search Engine Result Pages (SERPs) serve as the digital gateways to the vast expanse of the internet. Past decades have witnessed a surge in research primarily centered on the influence of website ranking on these pages, to determine the click-through rate (CTR).

arxiv-2402-14223.title: Interacting light thermal-relic dark matter: self-consistent cosmological bounds
arxiv-2402-14223.creator: Rui An, Kimberly K. Boddy, Vera Gluscevic
arxiv-2402-14223.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rui An, Kimberly K. Boddy, Vera Gluscevic. We analyze cosmic microwave background (CMB) data to constrain the mass and interaction strengths of thermally-produced dark matter (DM) in a self-consistent manner, simultaneously taking into account the cosmological effects of its mass and interactions. The presence of a light thermal-relic particle contributes non-negligibly to the radiation density during Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN), altering the light-element yields, as well as the the effective number of relativistic particle species.

arxiv-2412-18376.title: Bidirectional Topic Matching: Quantifying Thematic Overlap Between Corpora Through Topic Modelling
arxiv-2412-18376.creator: Raven Adam, Marie Lisa Kogler
arxiv-2412-18376.description: Abstract This study introduces Bidirectional Topic Matching (BTM), a novel method for cross-corpus topic modeling that quantifies thematic overlap and divergence between corpora. BTM is a flexible framework that can incorporate various topic modeling approaches, including BERTopic, Top2Vec, and Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA).

arxiv-2505-06697.title: Kinetic framework with consistent hydrodynamics for shallow water equations
arxiv-2505-06697.creator: S. A. Hosseini 1, I. V. Karlin 1
arxiv-2505-06697.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. A. Hosseini 1, I. V. Karlin 1. We present a novel discrete velocity kinetic framework to consistently recover the viscous shallow water equations. The proposed model has the following fundamental advantages and novelties: (a) A novel interpretation and general framework to introduce forces, (b) the possibility to consistently split pressure contributions between equilibrium and a force-like contribution, (c) consistent recovery of the viscous shallow water equations with no errors in the dissipation rates, (d) independent control over bulk viscosity, and (e) consistent second-order

arxiv-2508-08294.title: Epidemic Spreading with Co-infection on Long-Range Random Networks
arxiv-2508-08294.creator: Frank Namugera
arxiv-2508-08294.description: Abstract We study a discrete-time co-infection epidemic model on spatial networks incorporating both random and long-range interactions. Using numerical analysis, we investigate how the co-infection recovery rate ( μ \mu ), the interaction distance decay exponent ( α \alpha ), and network connectivity parameters affect epidemic persistence.

arxiv-2509-15723.title: REFER: Mitigating Bias in Opinion Summarisation via F re quency F ram e d P r ompting
arxiv-2509-15723.creator: Nannan Huang, Haytham M. Fayek, Xiuzhen Zhang
arxiv-2509-15723.description: Abstract Individuals express diverse opinions, a fair summary should represent these viewpoints comprehensively. Previous research on fairness in opinion summarisation using large language models (LLMs) relied on hyperparameter tuning or providing ground truth distributional information in prompts. However, these methods face practical limitations: end-users rarely modify default model parameters, and accurate distributional information is often unavailable.

arxiv-2601-08865.title: Stimulating Higher Order Thinking in Mechatronics by Comparing PID and Fuzzy Control
arxiv-2601-08865.creator: Christopher J. Lowrance John R. Rogers Artificial Intelligence Task Force Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering US Army Futures Command United States Military Academy Email: christopher.j.lowrance.mil@mail.mil West Point, NY USA Email: john.rogers@westpoint.edu
arxiv-2601-08865.description: Abstract Many studies have found active learning, either in the form of in-class exercises or projects, to be superior to traditional lectures. However, these forms of hands-on learning do not always get students to reach the higher order thinking skills associated with the highest levels of Bloom’s Taxonomy (i.e., analysis, synthesis, and evaluation).

pmc-12556495.description: BackgroundCommunity Health Workers (CHWs) are crucial to improving access to maternal care in Peru, especially in rural and indigenous communities. pmc-12663443.title: Research and application of quantitative model for optimal well trajectory selection
pmc-12663443.creator: Yue Xiao, Tuo Zhou, Hang Su, Jinlong Li, Lu Song, Xiangji Kong, Feng Qian

Currently, the selection of wellbore trajectories is mainly evaluated based on operational feasibility and target safety. However, the trajectory plan that is easy to construct and smoothly hits the target May have potential disadvantages such as high drilling costs, poor stress state of the drill string, difficulty in meeting wellbore cleaning requirements, and long drilling cycles.

pmc-12732525.title: Applications of Medical Mediation: A Systematic Review of Its Role in Healthcare Dispute Resolution and Bioethical Decision-Making
pmc-12732525.creator: Olympia Lioupi, Polychronis Kostoulas, Konstadina Griva, Charalambos Billinis, Costas Tsiamis
pmc-12732525.description: Background: Medical mediation offers a patient-centered, collaborative alternative to traditional resolution methods for healthcare conflicts that is gaining international traction in an increasingly complex environment of advancing technology and diverse patient populations. This systematic review aims to synthesize the literature on medical mediation and analyze its clinical applications, conflict typologies, involved actors, mediation methodologies, legal frameworks, and theoretical underpinnings.

pmc-13217243.title: Ectopic ACTH syndrome in an adult with metastatic Ewing sarcoma
pmc-13217243.creator: Deborah A Osafehinti, Jennifer M Kaplan, Elise F Nassif Haddad, Steven G Waguespack
pmc-13217243.description: Ectopic adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) syndrome (EAS) accounts for 8-18% of Cushing syndrome cases and is typically due to neuroendocrine tumors such as small cell lung carcinoma and bronchopulmonary neuroendocrine tumors. EAS arising from Ewing sarcoma (EwS) is rare, with only 9 pediatric and 5 adult cases reported to date.

pmc-13695472.creator: Marina Romozzi, Juan Luis Alcala‐Zermeno, Antonio Funcis, Federico Tosto, Marta Piccioli, Luigi Francesco Iannone, Riccardo Maviglia, Masahito Katsuki, Yasuhiko Matsumori, Paolo Calabresi, Raffaele Iorio, Catello Vollono
pmc-13695472.description: ObjectivesSuper‐refractory status epilepticus (SRSE) is a neurological emergency with high morbidity and mortality. uslaw-usc-t12-s5904.title: 12 U.S.C. § 5904 — Approval of subsidiaries of insured depository institutions and Federal qualified payment stablecoin issuers
uslaw-usc-t12-s5904.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s5904.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 56 (Regulation Of Payment Stablecoins). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Application (1) In general Each primary Federal payment stablecoin regulator shall— (A) receive, review, and consider for approval applications from any insured depository institution that seeks to issue payment stablecoins through a subsidiary and any nonbank entity, Federal branch, or uninsured national.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1652.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1652 — Citizens as pirates
uslaw-usc-t18-s1652.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1652.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 81 (Piracy And Privateering). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, being a citizen of the United States, commits any murder or robbery, or any act of hostility against the United States, or against any citizen thereof, on the high seas, under color of any commission from any foreign prince.

uslaw-usc-t40-s902.title: 40 U.S.C. § 902 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t40-s902.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s902.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Chapter 9 (Urban Land Use). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter, the following definitions apply: (1) Unit of general local government.— The term “unit of general local government” means a city, county, town, parish, village, or other general-purpose political subdivision of a State. (2) Urban area.— The term “urban area”.
